about: Fixed official album master; sampleless soft-mallet/sub/electro/wordless background gestures. Stem-derived guides and134.766BPM analysis clock are not recovered MIDI/gear/speech. No tape noise/wobble model or reference samples/input.

tha-kit.about: Electro / 808-classic drum machine: booming kick, two-tone snare, clap, cowbell, clave and six-square metallic hats. For electro, Miami bass, synth-pop and early hip-hop. Pieces: k kick, kl long kick (choke bd), s snare, cp clap, rs rim, cl clave, ma maracas, cb cowbell, h closed / oh open hat (choke), cy cymbal, lt mt ht toms, lc mc hc congas, zp zap. Accents (velocity) add click, snap and brightness. Try `chirp -t 128 @beat-electro`.

tha-mallet.about: Concert marimba: warm rosewood bars over resonators, round when soft and knocking with overtones when hard. The bars are tuned 1:4:10, and low bars bloom and sustain longer than high ones. Rolls are ratchets (`C4/2^r=12^ramp=0.9`), `^dead` presses the mallet into the bar (a choked stroke), `^h` is a lighter second-mallet touch.

tha-sub.about: Clean sine sub-bass with a touch of 2nd harmonic; mono, glides slightly. Doubles a distorted bass an octave down or in unison.
fx: reverb kind=room decay=.8s mix=.18 low_cut=30 high_cut=1400

tha-voice.about: Sampleless spoken-vocal gestures: a softer opt-in sibling of kidman, without its scream/period-doubling and with gentler rasp, effort and drive. No TTS or intelligible lyrics are claimed. Use flux-timed syllables and ^on/^off/^dvow marks (stemvox --onsets flux --grid 0.03125 --min 0.0625 --phones); do not replace a sparse pitched-vocal line without compensating the increased voiced duration. First measured on Mind's Mirrors. Existing harsh-vocal defaults are unchanged (bd-855e25).
